deterministic_horizon_arithmetic.interpretation: Upper bound on non-overlapping 20T calendar windows in 365 days; not an empirical count of independent outcomes or proof of adequate power.

initial_findings: Overlapping forecasts remove the mathematical coverage ceiling but do not guarantee observed coverage or accuracy.
Separate model accuracy from unresolved-feed outcomes and report label-resolution rate; unresolved final labels must not be silently dropped.
365 days are insufficient for 200 non-overlapping 20T calendar windows at 4h and longer; the daily horizon alone allows only 18.25 such windows.
Make per-cell development and per-selected-cell final opportunity keys explicit; use idempotent forecast IDs and define sealing after each 20T deadline.
A 200-window floor is not independence or power proof; fully define block resampling and all multiplicity gates.
Add operations headroom, host clock, exchange feed semantics, per-stream completeness, quarantine and release gates before capture.
baseline_and_inference_findings: R005 macro-only same-anchor comparator is tautological because candidate direction equals the confirmed BTC regime at every emitted candidate anchor.
Policy-level comparisons on each policy's own anchors estimate whole-policy behavior, not isolated signal selection; geometry differences also change target-first outcomes and risk.
Validation-frozen coverage thresholds do not guarantee equal final coverage or anchor/regime composition; report realized final coverage and do not call it test-matched.

Synchronized time-block resampling does not create paired observations for policies with different anchors; conditional precision, matched-geometry ablation, and common-calendar policy P&L are separate estimands.
The proposed composite p-value and confirmatory Holm acceptance language were withdrawn; exact statistics, variance/studentization, null-centering and validity checks remain unspecified.
Baseline policy mechanics, including aggression direction/ties, randomization inputs/seed/scope, capital and overlapping-position rules, remain incomplete.
remaining_open_design_gates: Exact model/calibration implementation and minimum train/calibration/validation counts.
Final UTC issue start/end per timeframe, user fee schedule and permissible feed-use/retention terms.
Storage/capacity and multi-symbol reconnect/recovery evidence; no capture is authorized.
review_disagreements_or_limitations: Three follow-up reviewers evaluated the supplied protocol summary rather than reading the file directly; one direct file-based adversarial review identified the main estimand and missing-label issues.
The statistical reviewer confirmed no remaining simple arithmetic contradiction but states duration/block floors do not prove independence, power, or valid p-values.
